question: Within 140 kilometers, where can I find a gallery aligned with the route to Fred Crabtree Park, Herndon, VA from Former Gundry/Glass Hospital (Grand Gundry Sanitarium), Baltimore, MD?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_Intersects( geometry :: geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gundry/Glass Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Baltimore%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MD%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT P.geometry FROM parks AS P WHERE P.park_name ILIKE '%Fred Crabtree Park%' AND ST_Intersects( P.geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Herndon%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 ) ) LIMIT 1 ) ) :: geography, 140000 ) );
